titles.psychologyFormula: Curiosity Gap → Drama/Tragedy → Authority/Brand Recognition → Open Loop
titles.example: The INSANE Rise & Fall of Blockbuster
titles.notes: Works best for massive companies or famous personalities that crashed hard.

titles.psychologyFormula: Leveraging familiarity with modern icons to introduce historical counterparts.
titles.example: The SCANDALOUS Lives of the Gabor Sisters | The Original Kardashians
titles.notes: Creates an immediate point of reference using modern icons.

scripts.scriptFormatName: Rise and Fall Tragic Heroine Documentary
scripts.hookFormula: Familiar Modern Phenomenon + Introducing the Precursor + Dramatic Origin Story/Promise
scripts.introStructure: Establish as historical precursors to modern celebrity culture, outline dramatic life trajectory, highlight key life events, promise nuanced exploration.
scripts.storyFlow: Origin (Humble beginnings) -> Call to Adventure (Ambition) -> Trials (Marriages, war) -> Climax (Peak fame, scandals) -> Fall (Loss of self, decline)
scripts.retentionPattern: Constant escalation of status interspersed with scandals.
scripts.ctaPlacement: End of video reflecting on legacy
scripts.exampleStructure: The Gabor Sisters: The Shocking Original Kardashians
